_textstil: EINHEITLICHER STIL fuer alle content-Texte (Hotspots): Englisch, Praesens, dritte Person ('the people', 'the station'). title = kurze Nominalphrase ohne Zusatz/Gedankenstrich. body = 2-4 kurze Saetze, hoechstens ein Gedankenstrich pro Text, keine Ich-Zitate, ruhiger dokumentarischer Ton.

content.title: Weltkugel
content.body:
Test-Rasterbild. Steht mittig und wackelt nur leicht (bob).
Weitere Objekte einfach als neue Entities mit eigenem Bild ergänzen.

entities._kommentar: SCENE 2 (die station). 'variants'=Ordner mit Bild-Varianten. Bewegungs-Felder (Locomotion-Recherche): swim ('pulse'=Qualle, 'jet'=Kalmar), ease (Ebben/Hovern), weave (seitl. Pendeln), jitter (Station-Keeping), faceForward/facing (Sprite zeigt nach vorn). TIEFE/3D: 'layer' (0..<1, hoeher=weiter vorn; Station=1 immer ganz vorn) + Groesse (scale) + Deckkraft (opacity) gestaffelt -> atmosphaerische Perspektive (fern=klein/blass, nah=gross/kraeftig). Krill+Fischschwaerme sind PROZEDURAL (drawScene2Fauna).

STATION-INFO-HOTSPOTS (Szene 2). Der 'The station'-Marker oeffnet KEINE Unterszene mehr, sondern blendet diese Hotspots direkt auf dem sichtbaren Bimsstein ein (stationInfo:true -> nur bei aktivem Marker; stOff = Offset in Stein-Radien, sitzt live am Stein). Klick -> Callout-Etikett wie bei den Section-Hotspots.
entities.label: Floating stone

content.title: Floating stone
content.body: The station is not a ship, and it is anchored to nothing. It is a drifting block of pumice — porous volcanic rock light enough to float. Constant eruptions on the drowned seafloor push these giant rafts of stone to the surface, and the people hollow them out, living in the bubbles and cavities the rock already holds.

content.title: Below the surface
content.body: The sun is lethal now, so the water itself is the shelter. The people live beneath the surface, where the sea shields them, and everything is layered downward into the shielded dark. Only the station's highest point breaks into open air: the Solar Space, the single room that receives natural light.

content.title: Living light
content.body: Apart from the Solar Space, no daylight reaches the inside. Every passage and chamber is lit by living light: fluorescent bacteria, glowing fungi and bioluminescent plants, grown along the walls like a tended crop. The Sea Devils that gather around the station add their slow glow from outside.

content.title: Weighted keel
content.body: Raw floating stone would roll in the swell, so the station is trimmed like a keel. Heavy ballast in the lower modules pulls the centre of gravity deep below the waterline, while the upper third is kept deliberately light. Pushed by the waves, the station always returns upright — holding its light-bearing crown to the surface.

content.title: Found and grown
content.body: The people work the pumice like found rock. They settle into its natural hollows and open new ones only where the stone allows. Where a surface must be sealed or a form shaped, they grow a hard mineral crust (Biorock) — and even that the sea reworks in its own way, so the architecture is co-authored by the ocean.

content.title: Breathing drift
content.body: The station drifts slowly across the ocean, steered by warming the water around it with focused sunlight. As currents move through the mineral hull, it groans without pause — a sound the people call the breathing of the world. Inside, they navigate the dark by the songs that belong to each place.

entities._kommentar: WILDLIFE-INFO-HOTSPOTS (Szene 2). Der 'Wildlife'-Marker oeffnet KEINE Unterszene mehr, sondern blendet diese Hotspots direkt in Szene 2 ein (wildlifeInfo:true -> nur bei aktivem Marker; feste Bildposition ueber path). Klick -> Callout-Etikett wie bei den Station-Info-Hotspots.
entities.label: The deep rose up

content.title: The deep rose up
content.body: The collapse left only a few survivors, but for them the drowned world is near-perfect: populations have swelled, and most animals grow to at least twice the size of their ancestors. Because the light now kills from above, the old order has inverted — creatures of the deep and the open ocean spread up into the shaded middle depths. Krill anchors the whole food web, and the whales together now outweigh what is left of humanity. On land, almost nothing survives.

content.title: Bound to the station
content.body: Where the sea once kept its distance from people, life now gathers around them. Drawn by warmth and by the small life the human presence feeds, fish, sponges, jellyfish and glowing hunters colonise the drifting stone like a reef — the Sea Devils among them, whose steady glow the people have made their light. Each station carries its own gathered ecosystem as it drifts, a knot of life in an empty sea.

entities._kommentar: Tiefsee-Seadevil: gross, tief lauernd; Tiefen-Verdunkelung macht ihn schemenhaft.

SCENE 3 (das eye). Heller Kuppel-Innenraum (drawSolarSpace). Bild-Sprites wie Scene 2: 'variants'=Ordner. Phase 3 = nur Bild, daher alle interactive:false (kein Klick/Panel). Figuren sitzen am Beckenrand (y~0.74-0.80, Wasserkante bei y-von-unten 0.20), fast still (kleines bob). Tuecher (cloth) treiben langsam auf. Fehlen Bilder -> prozeduraler Platzhalter.
Optional: treibendes Tuch/Token der Mond-Gabe, langsam aufsteigend.

SECTION (der Schnitt). Klickbare Hotspots ('hotspot:true' -> pulsierender Gold-Ring statt Bild). interactive:true -> bestehende Klick->Panel-Mechanik. Position = einzelner Pfadpunkt (normiert). Texte englisch. Der 'sea_level'-Hotspot hat zusaetzlich action:'seaLevelRise' -> loest beim Oeffnen den Wasseranstieg aus.
entities.label: Magnetic field

content.title: Magnetic field
content.body: The planet's magnetic field has weakened, and it no longer deflects the sun's outbursts. Solar storms reach the surface as sudden, lethal spikes of radiation — without warning.

content.title: Ozone layer
content.body: CO₂, methane and the fossil fires tore the ozone layer open. UV and cosmic radiation now reach the surface almost unfiltered.

content.title: Photochemical smog
content.body: A permanent photochemical haze hangs over the water, toxic and self-renewing. It never lifts — and it tints the light a warm, filtered gold.

content.title: Sea level
content.body: The old coast lies far below. As the ice went and the water warmed, the sea climbed to today's level — swallowing the land where life once held on.

content.title: The living band
content.body: At the surface, an unprotected body takes a lethal dose within hours. The most stable water lies in a band just below — warmed from above, deep enough to blunt the radiation.

content.title: The cold deep
content.body: Below the warm band, the water turns cold and dark. Only a faint bioluminescent green still moves down there.

entities._kommentar: VIZ-HOTSPOTS. Wie die Section-Hotspots (hotspot:true -> pulsierender Gold-Ring, Klick -> Callout-Etikett). Die path-Koords sind PLATZHALTER: die Position wird zur Laufzeit von vizHotspotNorm() auf das gezeichnete Feature gesetzt (id-basiert). Texte englisch. SUN (scene 'sun', aus Szene 1).
entities.label: The lethal source

content.title: The lethal source
content.body: No one sees the sun directly; her light arrives filtered to a faint gold. Raw, it kills at the surface within hours — the reason is written in the sky.

content.title: The engine
content.body: The sun's uneven heat sets the whole water column turning — the currents that never rest. The people call this motion the breathing of the world.

content.title: Solar storms
content.body: Now and then the sun's field snaps and hurls a burst of plasma outward. With no magnetic shield left below, each burst arrives at the surface as a sudden, lethal spike.

entities._kommentar: STATION (scene 'station_cut', aus Szene 2). Querschnitt der Unterwasser-Station: Material, Funktion.
entities.label: Pressure hull

content.title: Pressure hull
content.body: A double shell of steel and composite holds back the weight of the water above. Rounded and seamless, it is built to be pressed on from every side — and to hold.

content.title: Life support
content.body: Sealed loops scrub the air and recycle every drop of water. Nothing that can be kept is vented — the station breathes on itself.

content.title: Ballast and buoyancy
content.body: Flooded and blown tanks trim the station's depth. They hold it in the safe band — never surfacing into the radiation, never sinking into the cold.

content.title: Airlock
content.body: The airlock is the only way in or out. Divers cycle through slowly, matching pressure, before the short, shielded swim in the open water.

entities._kommentar: LIVING (scene 'habitat', aus Szene 2). Leben im Stein: Wohnen · Bewegung/Immunitaet · Navigation/Licht. Texte im einheitlichen Stil (siehe _textstil oben) — die frueheren Ich-Zitate sind in die dritte Person ueberfuehrt.
entities.label: Dwelling

content.title: Dwelling in the stone
content.body: Rooms are not built but found in the pumice's natural cavities, and widened only where the stone allows. Shelves and beds are grown straight from the wall. Because the station never stops rocking, nothing rests loose — everything is tied down, or it belongs to the sea.

content.title: The sway
content.body: The station never holds still; it rolls, and the people roll with it. Ballast packed into the deepest rooms keeps the sway slow and shallow. Born to the motion, the inhabitants know no seasickness and read the tilt as a sense of their own — a body feels a wrong movement before any instrument shows it.

content.title: Finding the way
content.body: In the dark, the people navigate by four senses at once: the song that belongs to a place, the stone under the hand, the markers at the turns, and the lean of the floor. No light-shafts reach the dwellings. The light itself is grown — a crop of fluorescent biomass on the walls, joined by the glow of the Sea Devils.

entities._kommentar: SZENEN-BILDER (sceneImage:true): eigener Bild-Slot fuer jede Unterszene, die ein Hotspot/Marker oeffnet — funktioniert genau wie bei den Tieren und der Station: Bild(er) in den variants-Ordner legen (z.B. sun1.png oder sun1.webp; weitere Varianten sun2, sun3 ... moeglich, die Engine waehlt zufaellig eine). LIEGT EIN BILD DA, wird das prozedural gezeichnete Motiv der Szene ausgeblendet (Hintergrund, Caption und Klick-Hotspots bleiben). ORDNER LEER -> alles wie bisher, kein Platzhalter. Position = path (0..1 der Bildschirmflaeche), Groesse = scale (Bild-BREITE = scale * 2 * kurze Bildschirmseite). Die 'water'-Szene hat ihren Bild-Slot schon: 'land' in scenes.json (der Berg).

station_cut + wildlife sind aktuell nicht verlinkt (die Marker 'The station'/'Wildlife' blenden stattdessen Info-Hotspots in Szene 2 ein) — die Slots liegen trotzdem bereit, falls die Unterszenen wieder aktiviert werden.
